args.message:
fix(money): use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

round_money was quantizing with ROUND_HALF_UP, but the docstring and
FIN-212 specify banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN). This broke the
nightly build (tests/test_money.py::test_half_even), which expects
2.675 -> 2.68 but 2.665 -> 2.66.

args.body:
## Summary

The nightly build was failing because `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was quantizing with `ROUND_HALF_UP` — despite its docstring already claiming ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

## Change

- `src/money.py`: import and use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money`.

## Verification

CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed (includes `test_half_even`, which asserts `2.675 -> 2.68` and the banker's-rounding case `2.665 -> 2.66`).
